evidence_locator: sycophancy / FlipFlop section — challenging a model's answer, including a correct one, makes it capitulate and revise toward the perceived expectation rather than toward truth
headline thesis — a problem appearing a second time indicts the management system rather than the individual item or the team
organizational-learning-failure section — without a mechanism forcing a reference to past root causes, every recurrence becomes a fresh investigation even where the answer already exists
convergence-failure section — a reflection loop thrashes for four or more rounds without converging when the lesson buffer does not constrain the next attempt
rise-and-collapse failure mode — a self-improvement loop degrades the artefact it is improving past an inflection point
